symbols.label: Acceptance: the decision owner's disposition over an unchanged subject, exhausting only the instance and interval it names
Actor: whoever performs a step within a declared capability envelope (context, attention, time, capability)
Allowance: declared resource bound and spend measurement where capability fit or cost is the governed question
Applicability check: the check an unchanged consumer performs before reusing a closed result
Independent assessment protocol: freeze, expectations, named identity, no repair, no own authorship
Assessor: the relation that evaluates a frozen candidate independently
Authority: an identity-bearing permission to operate or to dispose acceptance within a scope
Basis: the exact immutable set of definitions a step, claim or result binds
Candidate: a step's output before evaluation
Carrier of a work item: durable ticket, sprint-local entry, or run or return record
Change class: goal_reprice, intent_reprice, product_reprice, requirement_reprice, design_reframe or realization_refactor, each with its re-entry point
Checker: a mechanical decider of the structural subset
Checkpoint: the exact state acceptance binds
Churn: rejected or superseded construction
Claim: an assertion with subject, property, basis, witness relation and falsifier
Standing of a corpus clause relative to the rc.2 builder: conserved, reframed, superseded or new
Closed result: a result with its basis, evidence, judgment and invalidators, available for reuse
Closure condition: the condition a work item stated for its own closure
Standing of a commitment relative to the others: recovered, derived, independent or hypothesis
Composition of steps s2 after s1
Admitted condition class with a declared disposition, including an explicit unknown class
Conformance: a realisation's interpreted behaviour satisfies a specification under a declared interpretation contract and an independent judgment
Conformance case: subject, mechanism under test, independently specified expected distinction, status
Transformation record: preserved, introduced, removed, external resolution witnesses, residuals
The chain Goals, Intent, Product Definition, Requirements, Design and realisation, Code or documents, Events, Projection, Delta, Scenarios, Gap analysis, Repricing
Constructor: the relation that produces the candidate and self-review
Context: the declared scope under which an interpretation holds (subject, definitions, basis, admissible observations)

The method's core statement: interpret a scoped subject; select a purpose and governing contract; transform within admitted authority while conserving its material relations; evaluate the resulting claims; continue, recover or conclude from current state under explicit uncertainty
Cost categories kept separate: startup, framework, external computation, transport, assurance
Counterexample case from the builder's own history, naming the mechanism that must catch it
Required obligation set R, admitted coverage C and uncovered coverage R minus C
Decision owner: the relation that disposes
Named dispositions after a non-satisfied result: continue within the contract, refine, recover, yield, re-enter the owning relation, terminate
Document map: the seven files, their tiers and what each owns
Envelope B: the actor's declared capability bound (context, attention, time, capability)
Evaluator: the relation that applies the declared relation between law and evidence
Evidence: artifacts, events, observations used to evaluate a claim on a basis
Executive relation: the declared consumer of returns in a coordinated configuration; selects the next already-authorised action
External test subject: a worked application, hello world or data mapper whose particulars cannot become generic method functionality
Falsifier: the observation that would defeat a claim, named before a witness is selected
Finding: an evidence-bearing item of a review with its smallest bounded correction
Fit test of the selected context against the envelope
The established categorical fragment: free category A on typed primitives, carrier sets I, cost pairs C_H, functors S and R_H
Grant: operations permitted, territory that may change, decisions reserved to others
Graph execution profile: binds the step to one vector or edge traversal and the roles to F_P, F_D and F_H
Hypothesis: categorical equivalence of A and I under some reformulation
Hypothesis: traversal composition laws of any runtime
Hypothesis: the statistical boundary construct at candidate status
Hypothesis: universal algorithmic capture of meaning
Hard stop: a condition that stops regardless of risk appetite
Declared policy on whether two activations of one actor family are independent for a semantic judgment
Intake: the activation record from which a step's governing relations are reconstructed
Interpretation: a declared contract from representation to meaning within a context
Invalidator: a changed material input, basis or declared revising observation that invalidates a result before reliance
Judgment: a recorded evaluation over an unchanged subject, with evaluator, decision, evidence, scope and revising observation
A declared latitude or transformation relation under which two values may differ lawfully
Compression that preserves the material distinctions and failure detections the evaluation needs
A layer of the chain; sufficient when a competent actor can derive a conformant next layer
Major ambiguity: ambiguity that changes architecture, boundary, admissibility or public contract
Material: of a relation, uncertainty or closure, that its change can alter a result, the validity of a basis, the sufficiency of evidence or an authority
Material closure of Z under R on the exact basis
The comparative baseline's criteria F27 to F30: native representation, onboarding, effectiveness evidence, work and resource measurement
Qualification of the method itself: a fresh constructor inside a declared envelope, then an independent evaluator against the mandatory relation population
Migration: the change path for a load-bearing shared contract
Object O: a subject with scoped identity (authority, kind, value), boundary, current state and declared material relations
Outcome U: a selected, owner-defined, directly verifiable state with an acceptance interval
Outer contract: a transformation T: A -> X with success predicates P0 ... Pn that steps refine
P0 Bounded construction
P1 Interpretation
P2 Purpose
P3 Identity
P4a Typed composition
P4b Conservation of step-produced facts
P5 Totality
P6 Justification and authority
Disposition of a predecessor claim: conserved, superseded, intentionally removed, or not applicable with a bounded reason
Preservation checkpoint: retention of unfinished work under an existing grant
Product roles: source project, release cut, product, install, artifact, development product
Profile: a domain extension that adds obligations, bindings and vocabulary and imports the core by reference
Profile binding: a declared binding of a core mechanism to a profile term, with direction, preserved meaning, narrowed scope and invalidation
Progress: accepted material movement toward the selected outcome
Proportionality: the relation between semantic ambiguity removed and effective reasoning complexity introduced
Proxy: an explicitly admitted bounded relation through which a human decision is exercised
falsified: a declared counterexample defeats it
indeterminate: admissible evidence cannot decide it
invalid_basis: the subject or basis cannot support the evaluation
out_of_frame: the evaluation needs an undeclared material relation or capability
satisfied: the declared predicate holds on the exact basis
The rc.2 builder corpus whose clauses this corpus conserves, reframes or supersedes
Reading route: for a stated purpose, the documents and sections to read in order

Recoverability benchmark: whether a fresh actor given only the published documents recovers the governing relations, with fidelity judged independently and reconstruction cost measured against the rc.2 baseline
Recoverability case: a fresh actor given only this corpus, with private knowledge withheld
A reference standing for a relation in place of its body
Faithful refinement of an outer transformation into steps T_i
Refinement: ambiguity outcome (resolved, carried, escalated, blocked)
Refinement: construction availability (candidate_ready, refused, incomplete, re_entry_requested)
Refinement: disposition (accept, local_repair, re_enter, reject)
Refinement: profile-defined closure decisions
Relation family R: dependency relations whose change can alter the result, basis validity, evidence sufficiency or authority
Representation: bytes, text, a model or a program standing for a subject
Residual: a material uncertainty, omission, loss or unproven relation that remains until an authorised disposition
Restart: a proposed reconstruction from less than the retained work
The one core result algebra for every evaluation and stop state
Resumption: re-entry of the same method over current work state by a possibly different actor
Review result: one core result per declared predicate with subject, basis, evidence, ranked findings, residual uncertainty, invalidation conditions and a recommended disposition
Seam: a relation crossing the boundary of the affected set
Seed set Z: subject, outcome and affected relations named in the intake
Selected context: the projection of the closure with its recorded boundary seams
Self-review: a constructor's own review of its candidate
Semantic fidelity: meaning and materiality
Semantic law: what an evaluation means
One implementation serving many instances
The shared constitutional WHAT located by a product definition's what bindings
Software design profile: binds the ontology-first derivation chain and the design laws
Specification Σ: the contract a realisation is judged to conform to
Steel thread: the smallest real path from a supported entry to a material outcome, widened by increments
Step: one bounded unit of work: intake, selected context, grant, execution, output
Step-produced fact: a judgment, residual, observation or authority decision produced by a step that cannot be re-acquired from declared sources; a reproducible observation is not one
Stop state: the one core result a step returns
Structural conformance: closed syntax, types, identities, references, bases and mechanically decidable predicates
Subject: the thing a claim, representation or transformation is about; exact, with inventory and bytes or semantic addresses
Successor: a cut that names the exact predecessor immutable cut whose claims it evolves
An independent realisation (HOW) located by a product definition's how.build_tenants bindings; derivative until its governing truth is ratified
Intake triage: change intent, class, re-entry point and when triage occurred
Trial case from the comparative baseline with a shared task and expected distinction
UX profile: binds reader and task obligations, operational projection and screen-level acceptance
Witness: the evidence selected to support a claim under a declared relation
Work state: current persistent workspace, governing basis, applicable closed results and judgments with their invalidators, residuals, and known uncertainty over external effects
Work wave: the current bounded selection of outcome-bearing work
World model profile: binds entity recovery, the entity cut, the attribute ledger, composition and the Markov-object construct at candidate status

arguments.literal: Acceptance binds one exact checkpoint and does not widen the outcome; the next already-authorised step may begin without renewed human approval when basis, affected set, decision envelope and re-entry conditions are already accepted; direct human acceptance is not weakened where Product or release law requires it.

clauses.statement: Acceptance binds one checkpoint and does not widen the outcome; an already-authorised next step needs no renewed approval; required direct human acceptance is not weakened.

arguments.literal: Acceptance exhausts the instance and interval; further work against it is preservation, a named prerequisite for another admitted outcome, or a new change requiring repricing.

clauses.statement: Acceptance exhausts the instance and interval; further work is preservation, a named prerequisite or a repriced change.

arguments.literal: Acceptance is the decision owner's disposition over an unchanged subject; recording it cannot widen it, and it exhausts only the instance and interval it names.

clauses.statement: Acceptance disposes an unchanged subject, cannot be widened by recording, and exhausts only its instance and interval.

arguments.literal: 'Algorithmic' means explicit and structurally checkable; a semantic decision is lawful only under an exact decision contract; structural success never establishes fidelity.

clauses.statement: Algorithmic means structurally checkable; semantic decisions need an exact contract; structural success never establishes fidelity.

arguments.literal: The governed question is capability fit or a cost claim.
The activation declares its allowance and how spend will be measured.

clauses.statement: Where capability fit or cost is the governed question, the allowance and its measurement are declared.

arguments.literal: Ambiguity is carried or decided by lawful probabilistic processing where policy allows, escalated to human adjudication where policy or risk appetite requires, and recorded either way.

clauses.statement: Ambiguity is carried, decided under policy or escalated, and recorded either way.

arguments.literal: resolved, carried, escalated and blocked are policy states over a core result.

clauses.statement: An ambiguity outcome is a policy state over a core result.

arguments.literal: The subject is frozen by identity before material reference exposure; the assessor records its expectations from the governing source before opening the candidate; it reads the subject at a named immutable identity, never a working tree; it makes no repair; it does not assess its own authorship.

clauses.statement: Freeze before exposure; expectations before opening; named immutable identity; no repair; no own authorship.

arguments.literal: Promotion needs independent assessment.
The assessor evaluates the exact live subject, authority paths, proof and installed state, not the constructor's summary.

clauses.statement: The assessor evaluates the exact live subject, not the constructor's summary.

arguments.literal: Authority for material growth derives from the selected outcome, an admitted bounded prerequisite or an admitted experiment, each with a stated exhaustion condition; ended authority is not renewed by repair, continuation or active status.

clauses.statement: Growth authority derives from the outcome, an admitted prerequisite or experiment with an exhaustion condition; ended authority is not renewed by activity.

arguments.literal: Authority is never minted from capability, a label or reachability.

clauses.statement: Authority is never minted from capability, label or reachability.

arguments.literal: UP-020 is conserved; the baseline's Executive, Worker and Reviewer are conserved by reference as labels for UP-020's roles; that a role is a relation an actor occupies is this corpus's ontology, not a claim about the baseline text; the preservation checkpoint, restart and the progress and churn categories are as in CALCULUS section 5.

clauses.statement: UP-020 and the baseline role labels are conserved; roles as relations is this corpus's ontology.

arguments.literal: The benchmark is the observable for the comparative baseline's criteria F27 and F28; F29 and F30 are the same observation reported with the task completed, the material errors detected and the cost.

clauses.statement: The benchmark is the observable for F27 and F28; F29 and F30 report the same observation with task, errors and cost.

arguments.literal: The carrier of a work item is selected for its required lifetime: a durable ticket where the work needs identity across sessions; a sprint-local entry where its only value is traceability inside a batch; a run or return record (the rc.2 run-scoped execution contract) where the work lives and dies with one activation. The triage fields are required wherever substantive work begins; a ticket per change is not.
Standing: conserves the TICKET core model's selection of the smallest lawful carrier; reframes its default, so that no carrier is the default and the triage fields are the required minimum.

clauses.statement: The carrier is selected for its required lifetime; the triage fields are required, a ticket per change is not.

arguments.literal: A case names its subject, the mechanism under test, the independently specified expected distinction, and its status; status is recorded when an actor other than the author runs it under EVALUATION's independent assessment and method qualification rules.

clauses.statement: A case names subject, mechanism, independent expected distinction and status; status is recorded only by a non-author run.

arguments.literal: A case passes when the expected distinction is observed and no coerced success appears anywhere in the result; a case that cannot be run with the declared subject returns out_of_frame, which is recorded, not hidden.

clauses.statement: A case passes only with the distinction observed and no coerced success; an unrunnable case returns out_of_frame, recorded.

arguments.literal: The chain runs Goals, Intent, Product Definition, Requirements (WHAT), Design and realisation (HOW, per tenant), Code or documents, Events, Projection, Delta, Scenarios, Gap analysis, Repricing. Each layer narrows ambiguity for the next: goals narrow focus, intent direction, product the current shape and terms, requirements obligation, tenant choice the realisation class, design structure, implementation detail.

clauses.statement: Each layer of the chain narrows ambiguity for the next.

arguments.literal: goal_reprice re-enters at the current work wave; intent_reprice at direction or scope; product_reprice at current product shape while intent holds; requirement_reprice at constitutional truth while direction holds; design_reframe at realisation structure while requirements hold; realization_refactor at local realisation with no intended upstream change.

clauses.statement: Each change class re-enters the chain at its named layer.

arguments.literal: Evidence change may invalidate a verdict without changing law; projection change may invalidate a view without changing truth; semantic change requires re-entry and invalidates dependent acceptance.

clauses.statement: Evidence, projection and semantic change have distinct invalidation effects.

arguments.literal: Changed material inputs or a declared revising observation invalidate the affected result before reliance, preserving the predecessor and any demonstrably independent surviving results; a changed basis invalidates likewise.
Return A Closed Result names inputs and observation; TICKET judgment continuity names basis.

clauses.statement: Changed inputs, basis or a revising observation invalidate the affected result before reliance; independent results survive.

arguments.literal: A changed governing relation is accepted only at its owner; accepting it inside the acting frame is a violation, whatever the size of the delta.

clauses.statement: A changed governing relation is accepted only at its owner, whatever the size of the delta.

arguments.literal: A checker decides the structural subset; it claims a semantic or authority subset only under an exact lawful decision contract supplied by the model.

clauses.statement: A checker decides structure; it claims semantics or authority only under an exact supplied contract.

arguments.literal: A claim names its subject, the property claimed, its basis, the relation between witness and claim, and its falsifier.

clauses.statement: A claim has subject, property, basis, witness relation and falsifier.

arguments.literal: A claim's quantifier, population and scope cannot exceed its evaluated evidence; generalising a local observation needs a declared inference relation, the comparable population and explicit counterexample treatment.

clauses.statement: Claim scope cannot exceed evaluated evidence; generalisation needs a declared inference relation.

arguments.literal: Every clause in this corpus has exactly one standing relative to the rc.2 builder: conserved (the rc.2 clause governs unchanged; route given), reframed (obligation kept, restated at a different scope or owner; route and change given), superseded (an accepted successor replaces it; route and successor given) or new (no rc.2 clause states it; requiring principle given).

clauses.statement: Every clause has exactly one standing relative to the rc.2 builder, with its route or requiring principle.

arguments.literal: A closed result is reused by an unchanged consumer after an applicability check; a role, conversation or resumption change alone invalidates nothing.

clauses.statement: A closed result is reused after an applicability check; role, conversation or resumption change alone invalidates nothing.

arguments.literal: A work item closes by the condition it stated, not by a reviewer's approval; a reviewer result is an input to closure, never the closure.

clauses.statement: A work item closes by its stated condition; a reviewer result is input, never closure.

arguments.literal: Compute the material closure of the seed set under the relation family on the exact basis; if the closure is not finite and unique, the step returns a gap or refusal and does not guess.

clauses.statement: The material closure is computed on the exact basis; a non-finite or non-unique closure returns a gap or refusal, never a guess.

arguments.literal: Every commitment has one standing relative to the others: recovered, derived with named premises, independent by an argued non-entailment, or hypothesis.

clauses.statement: Every commitment is recovered, derived with named premises, independent by argued non-entailment, or a hypothesis.

arguments.literal: The common conformance discriminators are each covered by at least one case; the comparative baseline's eight trials are conserved; the builder-history counterexamples are new, derived from the common inputs.

clauses.statement: Every common discriminator is covered by at least one case; the baseline trials are conserved; the counterexamples are new.

arguments.literal: A composite over several results declares its conjunction; the member it reports is chosen by that declared rule; every known failure and uncovered obligation survives the join and is carried with the composite; no universal order among the non-satisfied members exists.

clauses.statement: A composite reports by its declared conjunction; failures and uncovered obligations survive; no universal order exists.

arguments.literal: For steps s1: X -> Y and s2: Y -> Z, the composite s2 after s1 exists only under P4a; its output carries both steps' step-produced facts.

clauses.statement: A composite exists only under P4a and carries both steps' step-produced facts.

arguments.literal: A composition law is required only where the governing evaluation combines internal variables or transports values across steps; independent closed results may instead go to one declared conjunction.

clauses.statement: Composition law is required only where values cross steps; independent closed results may go to one declared conjunction.

arguments.literal: Whether a compression preserved what the evaluation needs is a claim with the standing of any other; the compressing step records the compression and its preservation argument; the claim is assessed independently only where the promotion it serves needs independent assessment.

clauses.statement: Compression preservation is a recorded claim, assessed independently only where the promotion needs it.

arguments.literal: A realisation conforms to a specification Σ when its interpreted behaviour satisfies Σ under a declared interpretation contract and an independent judgment.

clauses.statement: Conformance is interpreted behaviour satisfying Σ under a declared contract and an independent judgment.

arguments.literal: Conformance establishes neither identical behaviour outside Σ nor equal cost; semantic equivalence and computational equivalence are separate claims with separate evidence.

clauses.statement: Conformance establishes neither identical behaviour outside Σ nor equal cost; semantic and computational equivalence are separate claims.

arguments.literal: Conformance of a tenant is judged under EVALUATION's conformance rule; two conforming tenants need not behave identically outside the contract.

clauses.statement: Two conforming tenants need not behave identically outside the contract.

arguments.literal: Conservation is semantic: patch absence does not prove loss when a successor-native realisation preserves behaviour, and naming or code similarity does not prove conservation without relevant evidence.

clauses.statement: Patch absence does not prove loss where behaviour is preserved; name similarity does not prove conservation without evidence.

arguments.literal: candidate_ready -> satisfied; refused -> falsified; incomplete -> indeterminate; re_entry_requested -> out_of_frame or invalid_basis.

clauses.statement: Construction availability maps candidate_ready, refused, incomplete and re_entry_requested onto the core.

arguments.literal: For the context dimension the fit test is a measurement: the bytes of the selected context are measured before any read and compared with the declared cap; the measurement, the cap and the outcome are step-produced facts recorded before the read.

clauses.statement: Context fit is measured in bytes before any read and recorded as a step-produced fact.

arguments.literal: The table restates RF-012's five members unchanged; the no-coercion sentence restates AC-007's rule that a failed, missing, indeterminate, out-of-scope or invalid-basis result follows the declared algebra; both are conserved, restated once, and continue to govern.

clauses.statement: The core algebra conserves RF-012 and AC-007, restating both once.

arguments.literal: The core names no runtime, no carrier and no executor; terms owned outside the core, by a profile, a realisation or an rc.2 member (graph, edge, vector, traversal, ledger, event log, worksite, HoG, F_D, F_P, F_H, Markov overlay, module, screen, entity cut), never enter tier 1 or 2 except in a disposition table.

clauses.statement: The core names no runtime, carrier or executor; profile terms enter tier 1 or 2 only in disposition tables.

arguments.literal: The core statement is the one-sentence route into the method: interpretation (FOUNDATIONS P1), purpose and contract (P2, SPEC_METHOD section 3), transformation under authority conserving material relations (P4a, P4b, CALCULUS sections 2 and 4), evaluation of claims (EVALUATION), continuation and recovery from current state (CALCULUS section 5).

clauses.statement: The core statement routes a reader to interpretation, purpose, conserving transformation, evaluation and recovery.

arguments.literal: Startup, framework, external computation, transport and assurance costs are separated so that one cannot conceal another; supported input dimensions and workloads are declared before qualification.

clauses.statement: Cost categories are separated so none conceals another; supported dimensions and workloads are declared before qualification.

arguments.literal: Later counterevidence arrives.
Every dependent verdict is invalidated until the claim-evidence relation is requalified.

clauses.statement: Later counterevidence invalidates every dependent verdict until requalification.

arguments.literal: Each counterexample from the builder's own history names the mechanism that must catch it; its primary sources are reacquired when a case is designed for execution.

clauses.statement: Each builder-history counterexample names its catching mechanism and reacquires its sources at design time.

arguments.literal: Required coupled relations must fit together in some step; unrelated obligations stay outside the selected context.

clauses.statement: Required coupled relations fit together in some step; unrelated obligations stay outside.

arguments.literal: Delivery is sequenced around the smallest real path from a supported entry to a material outcome, established early and widened by increments chosen for consequential uncertainty, interface reach and failure impact; a passing path establishes only the relations it exercised.
Standing: reframed from the baseline's Steel-Thread Delivery, which governs its profile unchanged; restated here as a sequencing heuristic for any realisation, not law (P2).

clauses.statement: Delivery widens from the smallest real path; a passing path establishes only the relations it exercised.

arguments.literal: One capable context has sufficient authority and intake.
It enters directly as constructor; coordination is selected only when material contexts, authority or required independence need it.

clauses.statement: A capable context with authority and intake enters directly; coordination only when contexts, authority or independence require it.

arguments.literal: accept, local_repair, re_enter and reject are what the decision owner does with an assessed candidate; a disposition consumes a core result and is not one.

clauses.statement: A disposition consumes a core result and is not one.

arguments.literal: Dispositions after any non-satisfied result are named in advance: continue within the current contract when supported; refine; recover; yield; re-enter the owning relation; terminate. Each admitted condition class has a declared disposition, including an explicit unknown class.

clauses.statement: Dispositions after a non-satisfied result are named in advance; every admitted condition class, including unknown, has one.

arguments.literal: A valid parse, a valid map, a green test and a historical judgment each establish exactly their own claim.

clauses.statement: A parse, a map, a green test and a historical judgment each establish exactly their own claim.

arguments.literal: Neither evidence nor authority is minted by the other.

clauses.statement: Evidence and authority do not mint each other.

arguments.literal: An evidence surface, proof, matrix, coverage record or test suite cannot by itself select, enlarge or replace the outcome; where an assurance capability is itself defined as product behaviour, its delivery is progress and its evidence still does not author the claim.

clauses.statement: No evidence surface can by itself select, enlarge or replace the outcome; delivered assurance behaviour is progress whose evidence still does not author the claim.

arguments.literal: A composite with a known failure or an uncovered required obligation cannot project success; a known failure A and an uncovered obligation B survive every join.

clauses.statement: A composite with a known failure or uncovered required obligation cannot project success; both survive every join.

arguments.literal: An outer transformation T: A -> X with success predicates P0 ... Pn is faithfully refined by steps T_i when each admitted input satisfying P_i yields an output satisfying P_i+1, retains every applicable invariant, exposes other outcomes without coercion, and each output satisfies the next step's domain and preconditions; then a successful composite carries P0 to Pn by induction.

clauses.statement: Faithful refinement: each step carries P_i to P_i+1, retains invariants, exposes other outcomes without coercion and satisfies the next step's preconditions; the composite carries P0 to Pn by induction.

arguments.literal: A finding without evidence a consumer can chase is commentary.

clauses.statement: A finding without chaseable evidence is commentary.

arguments.literal: Within its grant a step selects refinement, sequencing and compression itself; selecting another actor or enlarging the envelope re-enters the owner of the grant or envelope, who may delegate that choice in the grant.

clauses.statement: A step selects refinement, sequencing and compression within its grant; actor change and envelope enlargement re-enter their owner.

arguments.literal: The selected context fits the envelope.
Activate.

If it does not fit, one or more of these, in combination: refine the outer contract into steps whose contexts fit; sequence activations; apply a lawful compression; select another actor whose envelope fits; or return out_of_frame.

clauses.statement: If the context fits, activate; otherwise refine, sequence, compress lawfully, change actor or return out_of_frame, in any combination.

arguments.literal: Where A is the free category on typed primitives, I the selected carrier sets with total functions and C_H pairs of functions with additive costs, S: A -> I and R_H: A -> C_H are functors; S is not faithful; S is not an equivalence.

Standing: new in this corpus (P1); rc.2 states only the obligation that a categorical claim defines its objects, arrows, identities and composition and proves preservation, and asserts no categorical functor itself. H names an architecture, never a runtime.

clauses.statement: The fragment, new in this corpus: under the stated interpretation S and R_H are functors, S is not faithful and not an equivalence; further categorical claims must be constructed and proved.

arguments.literal: The grant names the operations permitted, the territory that may change, and the decisions reserved to others.

clauses.statement: A grant names permitted operations, mutable territory and reserved decisions.

arguments.literal: The step binds to one vector or edge traversal; the roles to F_P (lawful probabilistic processing within one traversal), F_D (deterministic evaluation or proof over declared properties) and F_H (human adjudication under the traversal's declared authority); work state to the workspace, governed ledger and event-log triple; the result refinements to the profile's edge closure decisions with their declared mapping to the core; refinement to graph functions. The runtime owns traversal, admission, runtime facts, frames, continuations, lineage and projection; the product owns domain meaning, the function catalogue, policy overlays and domain proof interpretation; the framework never absorbs the worker's internal solution strategy. The loop's four functions are the profile's realisation of CALCULUS sections 4 and 5 and keep their distinct authority.

clauses.statement: The graph profile binds step, roles, work state, closure decisions and refinement to its runtime terms; runtime and product ownership stay distinct.

arguments.literal: Some conditions are hard stops regardless of appetite: a violated invariant, an absent required authority, a missing declared capability, an undeclared irreversible effect, an explicit human gate.

clauses.statement: A violated invariant, absent authority, missing declared capability, undeclared irreversible effect or explicit human gate is a hard stop.

arguments.literal: These are carried for falsification and are not law; nothing in the core depends on any of them being established.

clauses.statement: The four hypotheses are carried for falsification and are not law.

arguments.literal: An object's scoped identity (authority, kind, value) survives admissible state change and encoding change.

clauses.statement: Scoped identity survives admissible state and encoding change.

arguments.literal: Whether two activations of one actor family are independent for a semantic judgment is a policy the governing basis states for the claim.
Where no policy is stated, the default is that they are not independent.

clauses.statement: Independence across actor families is declared; the default is not independent.

arguments.literal: Declared inputs are acquired by their exact identity; a declared input absent from the actor's materialised view is neither licence to read elsewhere nor evidence that it is absent.

clauses.statement: Inputs are acquired by exact identity; an absent declared input is neither licence to read elsewhere nor evidence of absence.

arguments.literal: A step is activated from an intake sufficient to reconstruct its governing relations without conversation history, commentary or a prior actor's memory.

clauses.statement: An intake reconstructs the governing relations without history, commentary or a prior actor's memory.

arguments.literal: The intake names: the selected outcome, admitted prerequisite or experiment it serves; the affected relation set and its invariants; the exact basis and the inputs it may acquire, each by identity and hash or by an input commit; the grant; the conditions that require re-entry at an owning relation; and, where the governed question is capability fit or a cost claim, the allowance and how spend will be measured.

clauses.statement: The intake names outcome, affected set, basis and inputs by identity, grant, re-entry conditions and, where governed, the allowance.

arguments.literal: The actor's internal path within a step is not part of the output and is not governed.

clauses.statement: The actor's internal path is not output and is not governed.

arguments.literal: An interpretation says which distinctions a consumer may rely on and which are residual.

clauses.statement: An interpretation names the distinctions a consumer may rely on and the residual ones.

arguments.literal: A judgment is recorded over an unchanged subject with evaluator, decision, evidence, scope and revising observation.

clauses.statement: A judgment is over an unchanged subject with evaluator, decision, evidence, scope and revising observation.

arguments.literal: Green labels, document counts, review counts and historical outcomes are not acceptance.

clauses.statement: Green labels, counts and historical outcomes are not acceptance.

arguments.literal: Two values differ lawfully only through a declared latitude or transformation relation; preference, probabilistic choice and human presence are not implicit latitude.

clauses.statement: Values differ lawfully only under declared latitude; preference, probabilistic choice and human presence are not implicit latitude.

arguments.literal: Semantic law defines what an evaluation means; evidence supplies observations; the evaluator applies the declared relation; decision authority disposes; one actor may perform several and the record keeps them distinguishable.

clauses.statement: Law, evidence, evaluator and authority stay distinguishable in the record.

arguments.literal: A compression is lawful only when it preserves the material distinctions and failure detections the evaluation needs.

clauses.statement: Compression is lawful only when it preserves the distinctions and failure detections the evaluation needs.

arguments.literal: A layer is sufficient when a competent actor can derive a conformant next layer from it; derivation need not be unique; failure to derive is a defect of the upper layer.

clauses.statement: A layer is sufficient when a conformant next layer can be derived; failure to derive is the upper layer's defect.

arguments.literal: A load-bearing claim names its exact subject, the property, the governing basis, the witness relation, the nearest weaker property it excludes, and its falsifier, before a witness is selected; without these it is evidence discovery, not proof.

clauses.statement: A load-bearing claim is fully shaped, including its falsifier and nearest weaker property, before a witness is selected.

arguments.literal: Major ambiguity, the kind that changes architecture, boundary, admissibility or public contract, is detected and recorded at each boundary with its disposition: resolved, carried, escalated or blocked.

clauses.statement: Major ambiguity is detected and recorded at each boundary with its disposition.

arguments.literal: A relation, uncertainty or closure is material when its change can alter a result, the validity of a basis, the sufficiency of evidence or an authority; the relation family of a step is its material relations.

clauses.statement: Material means able to alter a result, basis validity, evidence sufficiency or authority.

arguments.literal: Proportionality applies to the method's own execution: source acquisition, context assembly, hashing, activation records, status recording and review serve an identified decision or assurance need.

clauses.statement: The method's own acquisition, assembly, hashing, records and review serve an identified decision or assurance need.

arguments.literal: The method is qualified the way it qualifies anything else: a fresh competent constructor, inside a declared envelope, using only the declared ordinary method and authority surfaces and declared trial subjects, with material reference outcomes, incumbent realisations, author memory and ad hoc rescue withheld until freeze wherever earlier exposure would compromise reconstructive independence; then an independent evaluator compares the frozen result with the method's mandatory relation population.

Standing: conserves Method Self-Qualification, which leaves the constructor, freeze and assessor protocols to the governing authority, and RF-013 for reconstructability; the surfaces rule and the conditional withholding conserve UP-022's qualification protocol.

clauses.statement: The method is qualified by a fresh constructor on the declared ordinary surfaces, with material reference outcomes withheld where exposure would compromise independence, then an independent evaluator.

arguments.literal: Where evidence is missing because a relation or capability needed to obtain it was not declared, the result is out_of_frame; indeterminate is reserved for the case where the declared capability was exercised and the admissible evidence still cannot decide.

clauses.statement: Missing evidence from an undeclared capability is out_of_frame; indeterminate needs the declared capability exercised.

arguments.literal: A step, claim or result binds one exact immutable basis; mixed bases need an explicit composite relation.

clauses.statement: Mixed bases need an explicit composite relation.

arguments.literal: The method does not require proving that no undiscovered material relation exists.

clauses.statement: No proof that no undiscovered material relation exists is required.

arguments.literal: No universal quota, ticket count, actor count or accounting carrier follows from the cost rule.

clauses.statement: No universal quota, ticket count, actor count or accounting carrier follows.

arguments.literal: A missing, failed or out-of-scope result returns its own member, never satisfied.

clauses.statement: Nothing is coerced to success.

arguments.literal: An obligation with no route to the selected outcome is unjustified.

clauses.statement: An obligation with no route to the outcome is unjustified.

arguments.literal: Independence for the assessed claim is preserved.
One actor may hold several roles.

clauses.statement: One actor may hold several roles where independence for the assessed claim is preserved.

arguments.literal: Adequacy of a transformation is judged against a selected, owner-defined, directly verifiable outcome with an acceptance interval.

clauses.statement: Adequacy is judged against the selected outcome and its interval.

arguments.literal: A finite actor realises a selected outer contract through steps; each step's selected context fits the actor's envelope; the actor's internal path within a step is its own.
Standing: recovered as a composite; the generic statement is reframed from the graph profile's graph functions.

clauses.statement: P0: a finite actor realises a selected outer contract through steps whose selected contexts fit its envelope.

arguments.literal: Subject, representation and interpretation are distinct; meaning holds within a declared context through a declared contract.
Standing: independent. With purpose, identity, evidence and authority fixed, two contracts give one representation two meanings.

clauses.statement: P1: subject, representation and interpretation are distinct; meaning holds within a declared context through a declared contract.

arguments.literal: A selected outcome defines adequacy; interfaces inherit material obligations from the transformation they serve.
Standing: independent. Identical capacity serves opposite purposes.

clauses.statement: P2: a selected outcome defines adequacy; interfaces inherit obligations from the transformation they serve.

arguments.literal: An object's identity is declared (authority, kind, value) and survives admissible change; current state, historical observation and representation identity stay separate; a boundary is a claim with a proof obligation.
Standing: independent. Equal capacity admits identity by persistence or by digest.

clauses.statement: P3: identity is declared and survives admissible change; state, observation and representation identity stay separate; a boundary is a claim with a proof obligation.

arguments.literal: Two steps compose only when the first's result type and judgment satisfy the second's domain and preconditions; composition retains both identities, intermediate results, judgments, evidence, authority, provenance and stop states.
Standing: independent.

clauses.statement: P4a: steps compose only under type and judgment satisfaction, retaining both identities and their facts.

arguments.literal: Judgments, residuals, observations and authority decisions the outer contract needs are recorded by the step that produced them.

Standing: derived; reframed from AC-009, AC-013, AC-005, UP-017 and UP-021, whose nine statements of conservation become one obligation with typed instances (authority, residual, judgment, frame, transition, successor claim, evidence by reference); each source clause continues to govern its own scope.

clauses.statement: P4b derives from P0, P2 and the step-produced-facts premise: the producing step records what the outer contract needs.

arguments.literal: A step can meet a condition outside its context and cannot report success on one; its result algebra carries indeterminate, out_of_frame and invalid_basis as first-class outcomes and its control model names the next move.
Standing: derived.

clauses.statement: P5 derives from P0, the open-world premise and P6: the result algebra carries non-success outcomes as first class and the control model names the next move.

arguments.literal: Definitions, assumptions, observations, candidate judgments and accepted claims have distinct standing; evidence supports a claim on a basis; authority permits or disposes within scope.
Standing: independent. A bounded actor satisfying all else can still take a green label as acceptance.

clauses.statement: P6: standings are distinct; evidence supports on a basis; authority permits or disposes within scope.

arguments.literal: The candidate is revised after exposure to the assessor.
The revision is a declared intervention and a new subject.

clauses.statement: Any post-exposure revision is a declared intervention and a new subject.

arguments.literal: The actor of one step need not be the actor of the next; a later actor may re-acquire declared sources but not a prior actor's private memory.

clauses.statement: The actor of one step need not be the actor of the next and cannot re-acquire private memory.

arguments.literal: A step's output is a candidate until evaluated.

clauses.statement: A step's output is a candidate until evaluated.

arguments.literal: The world is open: a step may meet conditions outside its selected context.

clauses.statement: The world is open.

arguments.literal: P0 presupposes a selected outcome (P2).

clauses.statement: P0 presupposes a selected outcome.

arguments.literal: A document set that requires private validator knowledge, whole-corpus loading or a prior actor's memory fails the benchmark regardless of its content.

clauses.statement: A document set needing private knowledge, whole-corpus loading or prior memory fails the benchmark.

arguments.literal: Software is recursive: a released product builds its successor, a dependent product, or artifacts. Source project (mutable), release cut (immutable boundary), product (released), install (stamped instance), artifact (published output) and development product (an install acting as builder) are distinct and named; the product definition is the source project's surface, not the release.

clauses.statement: Source project, release cut, product, install, artifact and development product are distinct; the product definition is the source project's surface.

arguments.literal: A profile may bind a core mechanism to one of its terms; the binding is declared in the profile with its direction, preserved meaning, narrowed scope and invalidation.
Standing: new (P0 boundary, P1); its shape follows ODD's specialisations of F_P and F_H, which ODD probabilistic compute owns in the graph-native context and carries as their provenance.

clauses.statement: A profile binding is declared with direction, preserved meaning, narrowed scope and invalidation.

arguments.literal: A profile declares its closure decisions' mapping to the core and may not add a core member.

clauses.statement: A profile declares its mapping to the core and may not add a member.

arguments.literal: A profile adds domain obligations, bindings and vocabulary; it imports FOUNDATIONS, CALCULUS, EVALUATION and SPEC_METHOD by reference and restates none of them.

clauses.statement: A profile imports the core by reference and restates none of it.

arguments.literal: Progress is accepted material movement toward the selected outcome; prerequisite work names what it enables; preservation and repeated proof are evidence, not progress; rejected or superseded construction is churn; discovering hidden distance revises the forecast and is not negative progress; volume of documents, code, tests, commits or reviews is not progress.

clauses.statement: Progress is accepted material movement toward the outcome; preservation is evidence, superseded construction is churn, volume is not progress.

arguments.literal: A projection cannot trim a required member to fit a carrier or budget.

clauses.statement: A projection cannot trim a required member to fit a carrier or budget.

arguments.literal: Project the closure to the selected context, recording its boundary: the excluded, external, unresolved, translated and invalidation-sensitive seams; material not in the closure stays out; adjacent material does not enter because it exists.

clauses.statement: The projection records its boundary seams; material outside the closure stays out.

arguments.literal: Proportionality is the relation between semantic ambiguity removed and effective reasoning complexity introduced; an obligation, distinction, carrier or document is justified when its contraction of the admissible interpretation space pays for the concepts, joins, exceptions and states an actor must hold to decide.

clauses.statement: An obligation, distinction, carrier or document is justified when the ambiguity it removes pays for the reasoning complexity it introduces.

arguments.literal: A human decision may be exercised directly or through an explicitly admitted bounded proxy whose grant names its scope and exclusions; a proxy cannot change Product meaning, requirements, governing authority or accepted design; such a change re-enters at its owning relation.

clauses.statement: A proxy acts within a named grant and cannot change Product meaning, requirements, governing authority or accepted design.

arguments.literal: Each clause names its requiring principle and, where it conserves, reframes or supersedes an rc.2 clause, that clause's route; a reader needing the rc.2 wording follows the route; the rc.2 cut remains the operative builder until STDO 3 is released.

clauses.statement: Every clause names its principle and its rc.2 route; rc.2 remains the operative builder until release.

arguments.literal: Goals are the current work wave; Product Definition is the present-tense shape of the mutable source project, not the released artifact; requirements state what the project must make true; design chooses how. Read models, commentary and generated views never outrank live specification.

clauses.statement: Read models, commentary and generated views never outrank live specification.

arguments.literal: For a selected activation, measure whether a fresh actor given only the published documents recovers the governing relations with fidelity judged independently, and at what reconstruction cost (context transferred, time, and spend where measurable), against the rc.2 corpus as baseline.
Standing: new; derived from P0 with the actor-change premise.

clauses.statement: The recoverability benchmark measures fresh-actor recovery of the governing relations, judged independently, and its reconstruction cost against the rc.2 baseline.

arguments.literal: A recoverability case gives a fresh actor only this corpus for a bounded activation on a declared subject, with the same task against the rc.2 corpus as baseline; a second case withholds validator folklore, author memory and whole-corpus loading, and the activation still succeeds or returns out_of_frame truthfully.

clauses.statement: Recoverability cases run a fresh actor on this corpus against the rc.2 baseline, with private knowledge withheld.

arguments.literal: The reference's owner, exact selector, authenticity, availability and completeness support the same consuming decision as the body.
Only then does a reference conserve the relation; an inaccessible or insufficient reference is a residual, not success.

clauses.statement: A reference conserves a relation only when it supports the same consuming decision; otherwise it is a residual.

arguments.literal: The refinement rule generalises ODD graph functions, which refine one outer vector into a small inner workflow, to any realisation; PROFILES section 2 keeps the ODD binding. UP-017 and UP-021 are conserved in this section.

clauses.statement: Refinement generalises ODD graph functions to any realisation and conserves UP-017 and UP-021.

arguments.literal: Coverage of the outer obligations, correctness of the local implications and legitimate authority are premises of the induction, not conclusions; 'each step passed' is weaker than 'the outer contract was conserved'.

clauses.statement: Coverage, local correctness and authority are premises; 'each step passed' is weaker than 'the outer contract was conserved'.

arguments.literal: A declared refinement answers a different question, keeps its own vocabulary and declares a total mapping to the core; no refinement adds a core member.

clauses.statement: Each refinement keeps its vocabulary and maps totally to the core; none adds a core member.

arguments.literal: Release identities, phases, naming, cohorts and publication follow RELEASE_METHOD by reference and are not restated; layer and release separation (AC-020) holds: a calculus, its interpretation of a subject and its carrier encoding keep independent content identities, judgments, supersession relations and proof obligations, and none is automatically an independently released product.

clauses.statement: Release mechanics follow RELEASE_METHOD by reference; calculus, interpretation and carrier keep independent identities, judgments, supersession relations and proof obligations.

arguments.literal: Report volume is not model traffic; transferred context is counted across every delegated actor, not only the coordinator.

clauses.statement: Report volume is not model traffic; transferred context counts across every delegated actor.

arguments.literal: Equal representations do not establish equal meaning; meaning is supplied by a declared interpretation contract within a declared context.

clauses.statement: Equal representations do not establish equal meaning.

arguments.literal: A material uncertainty, omission, loss or unproven relation remains a residual until an authorised disposition.

clauses.statement: A residual remains until an authorised disposition.

arguments.literal: A preservation checkpoint may retain unfinished work under an existing grant; a proposed restart, which reconstructs from less than the retained work, states why repair of retained work is insufficient, what survives and which causal assumptions change; reconstructability alone does not select reconstruction.
Standing: conserves UP-020 checkpoint and continuation.

clauses.statement: Retained work is preserved under its grant; a proposed restart must argue why repair is insufficient, what survives and which assumptions change.

arguments.literal: One core algebra of exactly these five members serves every evaluation and every step's stop state.

clauses.statement: One core algebra of five members serves every evaluation and stop state.

arguments.literal: Resumption does not imply idempotence: an action whose external effect may have occurred is not repeated blindly; the lawful results are reconciliation, yield or stop.
Standing: new (P5 with the open-world premise).

clauses.statement: An action whose effect may have occurred is not repeated blindly; reconcile, yield or stop.

arguments.literal: Resumption is re-entry of the same method over current work state by a possibly different actor. It recovers applicable progress, re-checks the invalidators of each reused result, reopens only affected support, and reconciles uncertain external effects before any repetition.
Standing: the invalidator re-check conserves Return A Closed Result; reconciliation of uncertain external effects is new (P0, P5 with the open-world premise).

clauses.statement: Resumption recovers progress, re-checks invalidators, reopens only affected support and reconciles uncertain effects before any repetition.

arguments.literal: A step's return goes to its declared consumer; in a coordinated configuration that consumer is the executive relation, which consumes closed results, applies disposition under existing decision authority and selects the next authorised action.

clauses.statement: A return goes to its declared consumer; an executive consumes closed results, disposes under existing authority and selects the next authorised action.

arguments.literal: Reusing the constructor's judgment does not satisfy independence; shared mechanical evidence may be reused, judgment may not.

clauses.statement: Mechanical evidence may be reused; judgment may not.

arguments.literal: A reused judgment does not satisfy a separately required independent judgment; the independent assessor acquires its own evidence and supplies its own judgment.

clauses.statement: A reused judgment never satisfies a required independent judgment.

arguments.literal: A review recommends a disposition; it does not apply one.

clauses.statement: A review recommends a disposition and does not apply one.

arguments.literal: A review returns one core result for each declared predicate it evaluated, with the exact subject and basis, the evidence consulted, the findings ranked by consequence, each finding's evidence and smallest bounded correction, the residual uncertainty and the invalidation conditions.

clauses.statement: A review returns one core result per predicate with subject, basis, evidence, ranked findings, residual uncertainty and invalidation conditions.

arguments.literal: Constructor, assessor and decision owner are relations an actor occupies over steps, not kinds of actor; no role name confers an operation.

clauses.statement: Roles are relations an actor occupies, not kinds of actor; no role name confers an operation.

arguments.literal: A reader selects the route for their purpose (understand the method; do a bounded piece of work; review someone's work; decide acceptance or release; apply the method to a domain; load it into a model's context) and reads the named documents and sections in order; the document map names which file owns which obligations.

clauses.statement: A reader follows the route for their purpose; the map says which file owns what.

arguments.literal: Every seam crossing the affected set includes its far side or states why it cannot participate.

clauses.statement: Every seam crossing the affected set includes its far side or states why it cannot.

arguments.literal: A constructor's self-review is construction output, not assessment.

clauses.statement: Self-review is construction output, not assessment.

arguments.literal: Several realisations may conform to one Σ; sufficiency does not require unique derivation or equality with an incumbent.

clauses.statement: Several realisations may conform to one Σ; sufficiency needs neither unique derivation nor incumbent equality.

arguments.literal: A change alters a load-bearing shared contract.
It is a migration, not a patch: change the authoritative contract first, audit every producer and consumer, migrate each, and chase every downstream effect before declaring completion.

clauses.statement: A load-bearing shared-contract change is a migration: contract first, audit and migrate every producer and consumer, chase every downstream effect.

arguments.literal: Computational similarity yields a commonisation candidate, never an adjudication of identity or authority; one implementation may serve many instances while each instance keeps its responsibility and binding.

clauses.statement: Shared machinery is a commonisation candidate, never an adjudication of identity or authority.

arguments.literal: Silent omission of required material to fit the envelope is never a lawful option.

clauses.statement: Silent omission to fit is never one of the options.

arguments.literal: Binds the ontology-first derivation of operation identities, logical completeness, prime contraction, the irreducible carrier set and projections; transformation admission completeness; invariant reconstruction sufficiency; computational realisation projection; foundation selection. All of DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD is conserved by reference. Whether a design boundary with no material alternative must still pay the full derivation chain is a residual question for the profile's owner.

clauses.statement: The software design profile conserves DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD by reference; the per-boundary cost of the derivation chain is a residual.

arguments.literal: Capability fit or a cost claim is the governed question.
The activation declares its allowance and reports spend with its measurement source, or records that the counter is unavailable.
Standing: new (P0 with UP-014's selection rule).

clauses.statement: Spend is reported with its measurement source, or the counter is recorded as unavailable (new in this corpus).

arguments.literal: A step's output is a candidate plus its step-produced facts (judgments with evidence, residuals, observations, authority decisions, provenance) and one stop state from the result algebra.

clauses.statement: A step outputs a candidate, its step-produced facts and one stop state.

arguments.literal: A step-produced fact is a judgment, residual, observation or authority decision produced by a step that cannot be re-acquired from declared sources; an observation reproducible from declared sources is re-acquirable, is not a step-produced fact, and is governed by sufficiency, not conservation.

clauses.statement: A step-produced fact is one that cannot be re-acquired from declared sources; reproducible observations are re-acquirable and governed by sufficiency.

arguments.literal: Every substantive change, whatever its intake label, enters through one intake triage that names the smallest lawful re-entry point; triage records the change intent, the class, the re-entry point and when triage occurred, wherever substantive work begins.

clauses.statement: Every substantive change starts with triage naming its class and smallest lawful re-entry point.

arguments.literal: A successor names the exact predecessor immutable cut whose claims it evolves, and gives every predecessor claim capable of affecting it one disposition: conserved, superseded, intentionally removed, or not applicable with a bounded reason. An undisposed claim blocks qualification of the affected claim.

clauses.statement: A successor names its predecessor cut and disposes every affecting claim; an undisposed claim blocks qualification.

arguments.literal: Tenant branches, worktrees, sparse cones, snapshot binding to an input commit, authorised reviews at named commits and merge on acceptance are local development law of the stdo_3 source project, stated once in its Product Definition and imported by reference.

clauses.statement: Tenant isolation and merge are the source project's local law, stated once in its Product Definition and imported by reference.

arguments.literal: Each tenant works in its own territory; a shared change returns to the WHAT's pen; a tenant never patches common WHAT or a peer realisation.

clauses.statement: A tenant never patches common WHAT or a peer realisation; shared change returns to the pen.

arguments.literal: A worked application, a hello world or a data mapper is an external test subject; its particulars cannot become generic method functionality by precedent.

clauses.statement: A test subject's particulars cannot become generic method functionality by precedent.

arguments.literal: Total handling does not claim that every external condition is recognised, that an invoked provider terminates, or that every request can be completed. A hanging external call, an unsatisfiable demand and a lost post-effect response are three different cases and none is solved by adding a value to the algebra.

clauses.statement: Total handling claims no omniscience; a hanging call, an unsatisfiable demand and a lost response are different cases not solved by a new algebra value.

arguments.literal: Every transformation records what it preserved, introduced and removed, its external resolution witnesses and its residuals.

clauses.statement: Every transformation records preserved, introduced, removed, witnesses and residuals.

arguments.literal: Admission of a material transition is one semantic commit of the complete transition within its enclosing relation, or none.

clauses.statement: A material transition is admitted as one complete semantic commit within its enclosing relation, or not at all.

arguments.literal: Trials declare a per-actor context cap and total-work budget before each run, include a required basis larger than the cap, count transferred context across every delegated actor, keep acceptance criteria independent of the constructing actor, and repeat probabilistic trials with varied task order.

clauses.statement: Trials declare cap and budget first, exceed the cap in required basis, count context across actors, keep criteria independent and repeat with varied order.

arguments.literal: For required obligations R and admitted coverage C, uncovered coverage is R minus C; combining results takes the union of known failures and recomputes uncovered coverage.

clauses.statement: Uncovered coverage is R minus C; combination unions failures and recomputes uncovered coverage.

arguments.literal: An rc.2 obligation capable of affecting this corpus that has no disposition blocks qualification of the corpus.

clauses.statement: An undisposed rc.2 obligation blocks qualification; this is UP-015 applied to the corpus itself.

arguments.literal: Binds reader and task obligations, operational projection and screen-level acceptance; UX_METHOD is conserved by reference.

clauses.statement: The UX profile conserves UX_METHOD by reference.

arguments.literal: A Σ admits materially different behaviours.
It either declares the latitude or is repaired before a decision-complete design is claimed.

clauses.statement: A weak Σ declares its latitude or is repaired before decision-complete design is claimed.

arguments.literal: Packaging, syntax, compilation, presence, invocation or local behaviour never substitutes for a semantic, authority-bearing, installed or end-to-end claim because the weaker property is easier to measure.

clauses.statement: A weaker property never substitutes for the claimed one because it is easier to measure.

arguments.literal: A product definition's what bindings locate the shared constitutional WHAT; its how.build_tenants bindings locate one or more independent realisations. Tenant-local realisation is derivative until its governing truth is ratified in specification.

clauses.statement: What bindings locate the shared WHAT; tenant bindings locate independent HOWs, derivative until ratified.

arguments.literal: Work state is the tuple of: the current persistent workspace; the governing basis; the applicable closed results and judgments with their invalidators; the residuals; and the known uncertainty over external effects. It is an object; its carrier (files, an event stream, another admitted owner) is a profile or realisation choice.

clauses.statement: Work state is a tuple of workspace, basis, applicable results with invalidators, residuals and effect uncertainty; its carrier is a realisation choice.

arguments.literal: Every outcome-bearing work wave names one selected, unresolved, directly verifiable outcome and its acceptance interval. Progress is judged only against it: material advance is progress; prerequisite work names the obligation it enables; preservation is evidence; regression blocks the affected path.

clauses.statement: A work wave names one verifiable outcome and its interval; progress is judged only against it.

arguments.literal: Binds entity recovery, the entity cut as the published identity-bearing unit, the attribute ledger, composition of local artifacts, and the Markov-object construct at candidate status; WORLD_MODEL_METHOD is conserved by reference; nothing in the core depends on the construct being established.

clauses.statement: The world model profile conserves WORLD_MODEL_METHOD by reference; the core does not depend on the Markov construct.

residuals.detail: PROFILES section 3 conserves DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD by reference, which requires the ontology-first derivation chain where it applies, while CALCULUS section 6 asks every obligation to pay for the ambiguity it removes. Whether a design boundary with no material alternative must still pay the full chain is not decided by this corpus; it is a question for the profile's owner.

The envelope has four dimensions (context, attention, time, capability). The context dimension is measured in bytes before any read; attention, time and capability have no measure or declaration format, and the documents do not say how a step records that the test was performed on those dimensions.

The categories A, I and C_H and the functors S and R_H are named with their interpretation and established properties but not constructed in this corpus; the fragment and its non-faithfulness result are new here and rest on the accepted C1 realisation's argument, which the standard does not carry; rc.2 states only the proof obligation. The program records the claim's shape, not a proof.

Each independent commitment carries a one-sentence non-entailment argument in its qualification. These are claims of independence with an informal witness each; none is formalised and P4a states none. The accepted C1 realisation argues them at greater length; the standard conserves only the sentence.

SPEC_METHOD section 7 imports the stdo_3 Product Definition's Development Isolation rules by reference. That document is outside this program's source basis, so the imported obligations are a route in the document, not clauses here.

Every encoded clause's rc.2 disposition is carried in the documents as a route, not in this program: the program's source basis is the tenant standards directory and rc.2 members are outside it. Conservation of an rc.2 clause therefore cannot be checked by this program's validation; it remains a semantic judgment over the documents and their routes.

frame_indexes.scope: Activate one bounded step under a declared envelope: intake, context construction, fit test, acquisition and the stop state it returns. Selected for the T-01 context-cap case.

Join bounded results under an outer contract: typed composition, conservation accounting, coverage, the declared conjunction, faithful refinement and the triage of a detected failure. Selected for the T-03 and T-04 cases.

A fresh actor given only the published documents performs a bounded evaluation step: the route in, the intake, the measured fit, the five-member result with evidence, the separation of claim, evidence, judgment and authority, the stop state and the handoff; with reconstruction cost measured. Selected for the R-01 and R-02 cases.

Assess a frozen candidate independently and dispose it: the assessment protocol, independence policy, review result shape, acceptance by the decision owner, closure by stated condition, reuse of mechanical evidence but never judgment.

Resume an interrupted construction over current work state: recover applicable progress, re-check invalidators, reconcile uncertain external effects before any repetition, detect unsupported completion claims, and complete the outer contract. Selected for the T-05 case.
